ns2:section.sectionText: Topic Section F: Screenwriting PREREQ: CW 100 or CW 104 This is an introductory class in the art of screenwriting. You’ll learn screenplay format and technique through reading, written exercises, workshops and discussion. Meanwhile, you’ll develop a premise and an outline for your own feature-length screenplay. Next, we’ll move into full-workshop mode, and you’ll write the first third of your screenplay.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to English or Rhetoric or Media and Cinema Studies or Creative Writing major(s) or minor(s).
